name: Standing Machine Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand upright facing the standing wrist curl machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
Rest the backs of your forearms flat against the horizontal padded table, allowing wrists and hands to extend just beyond the front edge.
Grasp the knurled rotating roller bar using an underhand (supinated) grip with palms facing up.
Lower your wrists downward under control into full extension to achieve a deep stretch across the forearm flexors.
Curl your wrists upward as high as possible against the resistance of the weight stack, squeezing the forearm flexors hard at peak contraction.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the weight back to the starting stretched position.
